source_text.body:
Let Google AI Mode find and check out a gift
A reporter set a target price and permission to buy for a haircare gift set; Google opened a prefilled checkout and also called nearby stores to check stock.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
In AI Mode the reporter asked for a luxury haircare gift set for his wife and got four options. On the Oribe Gold Lust set he used Track Prices, entered a target price (set to the current price as a test) and allowed Google to buy. Separately, he used Let Google Call, answering a few questions about the product, giving his location and confirming his email.
How it went
After several hours Google notified him and opened a checkout with his details prefilled; he stopped before buying. About half an hour after the call request, an email listed nearby stores and what each said about stock.
Worth knowing
Agentic checkout only works at eligible merchants that support it. The price-watch alert took several hours even with the target set at the current price.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Find [a specific gift, e.g. a haircare gift set for a friend with curly hair] and buy it only if the total comes to $[target price] or less. Check a few retailers, including whether [nearby stores or my city] have it in stock, and call stores if needed. Open the prefilled checkout and stop there, showing me the item, price, shipping and payment method before I approve the purchase.
Original source: https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/gemini/articles/tried-every-google-ai-shopping-093847432.html
